subject.title: wacli skill: add recipient allowlist and confirm-before-send enforcement

question: Should wacli outbound safety remain instruction-only, or should the WhatsApp plugin define an enforced recipient allowlist and redacted audit policy for wacli-style sends?
rationale: The requested behavior affects outbound authorization, persistent or workspace policy state, audit retention, privacy redaction, and whether skill text is enough versus runtime/tool enforcement.

options.title: Define plugin-owned enforcement
options.body: Create a WhatsApp plugin/wacli safety contract for recipient allowlists, redacted audit records, and bulk-send limits before updating the skill text.

options.title: Instruction-only hardening first
options.body: Tighten SKILL.md now with allowlist and audit guidance while explicitly tracking runtime enforcement as separate security work.

options.title: Keep current broad confirmation
options.body: Leave wacli on the existing confirmation guidance and rely on general exec approvals and operator configuration instead of adding a wacli-specific policy.

recommendation.title: Define plugin-owned enforcement
recommendation.body: Create a WhatsApp plugin/wacli safety contract for recipient allowlists, redacted audit records, and bulk-send limits before updating the skill text.

likelyOwner.reason: The wacli skill and its existing safety guidance trace primarily to steipete's feature history, with WhatsApp plugin ownership now established.
